question: 2017 年每个月的订单量是多少
sql:
SELECT 
    purchase_year AS year,
    purchase_month AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    dwd_orders
WHERE 
    purchase_year = 2017
GROUP BY 
    purchase_year, 
    purchase_month
ORDER BY 
    purchase_month
LIMIT 200

question: 2017 年每个月的销售额是多少
sql:
SELECT 
    o.purchase_year AS year,
    o.purchase_month AS month,
    SUM(p.payment_total) AS monthly_sales
FROM 
    dwd_orders o
JOIN 
    dwd_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE 
    o.purchase_year = 2017
GROUP BY 
    o.purchase_year, 
    o.purchase_month
ORDER BY 
    o.purchase_month
LIMIT 200

question: 2017 年每个月的延迟率是多少
sql:
WITH delayed_orders AS (
    SELECT o.purchase_year, o.purchase_month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
           SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_late = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_orders
    FROM dwd_orders o
    WHERE o.purchase_year = 2017 AND o.is_delivered = 1
    GROUP BY o.purchase_year, o.purchase_month
)
SELECT purchase_month, ROUND((delayed_orders * 100.0) / total_orders, 2) AS delay_rate_pct
FROM delayed_orders
ORDER BY purchase_month
LIMIT 200

question: 销售额最高的 10 个商品类目

question: 下单两次及以上的客户有多少人
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS repeat_customers
FROM dwd_orders
WHERE customer_unique_id IN (
    SELECT customer_unique_id
    FROM dwd_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
    HAVING COUNT(order_id) >= 2
)
LIMIT 200

question: 各支付方式的订单数与金额占比
sql:
SELECT 
    p.main_payment_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(p.payment_total) AS total_payment_amount,
    ROUND((SUM(p.payment_total) * 100.0) / (SELECT SUM(payment_total) FROM dwd_payments), 2) AS payment_amount_percentage
FROM 
    dwd_orders o
JOIN 
    dwd_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY 
    p.main_payment_type
ORDER BY 
    payment_amount_percentage DESC
LIMIT 200

question: 2017 年各月订单量的环比增长率
sql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        purchase_year,
        purchase_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM dwd_orders
    WHERE purchase_year = 2017
    GROUP BY purchase_year, purchase_month
),
monthly_orders_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        purchase_year,
        purchase_month,
        order_count,
        LAG(order_count, 1) OVER (ORDER BY purchase_month) AS prev_month_order_count
    FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT 
    purchase_month,
    ROUND((order_count - prev_month_order_count) / prev_month_order_count * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_orders_ranked
WHERE purchase_month > 1
ORDER BY purchase_month
LIMIT 200
